question: How is the joined threefold appearance declared in this architectural rule?
premises: jātyādi-traya-saṃyuktam names the joined threefold class
ābhāsam is the appearance being declared
inference: The verse defines the appearance as joined with the threefold class-beginning set.
uncertainties: exact members of jātyādi-traya are not expanded here
plain_english: The appearance joined with the threefold class-beginning set is thus declared.
